annotations.title: Bulk update listing prices or MOQ

description: Change the price or the minimum order quantity on up to 200 of your listings. Requires sign-in with seller access. price_set writes a dollar price, the percent modes adjust the current price, and moq_set writes a minimum order quantity. Previous values are replaced.

mode.description: What to change and how: price_set writes an absolute USD price, price_percent_increase / price_percent_decrease adjust the current price by a percentage, moq_set writes a minimum order quantity.

value.description: USD price for price_set, percent (0-1000) for percent modes, integer units (1-999999) for moq_set.

name: bulk_update_listings
title: Bulk update listing prices or MOQ
